$comment: Basketball leagues. Add one by appending an entry — nothing in the model or API hardcodes these ids. `oddsSportKeys` are The Odds API sport keys (upcoming games + bookmaker odds). `espn` is the slug pair used by ESPN's public API for RESULTS and team info; a league without one still shows upcoming games and market probabilities, just no Elo model — the UI says so instead of pretending.

history.$comment: How many past seasons to ingest by default. Basketball rosters turn over fast, so deep history matters much less than in tennis: 8 seasons is plenty for stable Elo and keeps the ingest quick.
history.$comment_538: Real NBA game-by-game results 1946–2015 (FiveThirtyEight). Used to FIT and VALIDATE the model on a large real sample, and as a guaranteed-reachable fallback when ESPN is blocked. It stops in 2015, so it is never the source for current ratings on its own.
